source_quote.quote: Note: Patients with IDH wildtype grade III anaplastic astrocytoma (1p19q intact) are also elgibile, as these tumors are expected to behave similarly to grade IV glioma.

coder_notes: Registered arm labels conflict with the description: registry arms are 'Group A: tepotinib alone' and 'Group B: tepotinib and osimertinib', whereas the description has Group A = brain metastases (tepotinib), Group B = recurrent glioblastoma (tepotinib alone), Group C = EGFR+ NSCLC brain metastases (tepotinib + osimertinib). Arms copied from registered labels; the GBM cohort receives tepotinib alone. MET alteration required in all groups (eligibility, matched to tepotinib); METex14 required for phase 1b Group A (NSCLC only). GBM group is phase 1a only, with surgical window, tumour tissue and CSF PK/PD including phospho-MET. Regimen coded combination because of the osimertinib group; the GBM group is tepotinib monotherapy. Treatment setting: GBM recurrent only, brain metastases newly diagnosed or recurrent -> both. IDH-wildtype grade III (1p19q intact) also allowed in the GBM group; arms left empty for IDH because the registered labels do not match the GBM cohort.
